title: AnthropicProxy
description: supabase/functions/anthropic-proxy/index.ts. POST only. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <supabase JWT> + apikey: <anon key>. This is a TRANSPARENT reverse proxy of Anthropic's POST /v1/messages — the function only inspects/constrains `model` and `max_tokens` on the request, and passes every other field through unchanged. It also forwards the client's `anthropic-version` and `anthropic-beta` headers verbatim (the latter is required for the `computer` tool used by ComputerUseOrchestrator/ElementLocationDetector to work at all). The success response (streamed SSE when request.stream=true, else JSON) is Anthropic's own Messages API response, forwarded byte-for-byte — this schema does not redefine that upstream shape, only the request fields Mira's proxy actually validates and the proxy-specific error shapes.

AnthropicProxyRequest.title: AnthropicProxyRequest
AnthropicProxyRequest.description: Passthrough of the Anthropic Messages API request body. Only `model` and `max_tokens` are inspected server-side; everything else (messages, system, tools, tool_choice, stream, metadata, etc.) is forwarded as-is to api.anthropic.com/v1/messages.

model.title: AnthropicProxyModel
model.description: Server-side allowlist (ALLOWED_MODELS in the function) — any other value is rejected with model_not_allowed. This list is a snapshot as of this audit and WILL drift as Mira adopts new models; treat it as a live value to re-derive from source at codegen time, not a frozen constant.

max_tokens.description: Capped server-side to a per-plan ceiling (free: 1500, pro: 8000, ultra: 16000) via Math.min — the client's requested value is silently reduced, never rejected, if it exceeds the cap.

stream.description: When true, the response is Content-Type: text/event-stream, metered by tapping message_start/message_delta usage fields inline. When false/absent, the response is application/json, metered from the final usage block.

model.description: Present only alongside error=model_not_allowed; echoes the rejected model name.
